guides.title: 1. Create & Inspect Your First VEGA Firmware Project
guides.description: Set up a portable VEGA ARIES V3 project from an example or template and verify board target alignment.

steps.title: Select Starter Example or Create Project
steps.detail: Pick 'Minimal C Firmware & Portable Makefile' in the Examples tab or create a fresh workspace via New Project.

steps.title: Verify Target Board Profile
steps.detail: Open Board Manager and confirm vega-project.json targets VEGA_ARIES_V3 (VEGA ET1031, rv32i_zicsr, THEJAS32).

steps.title: Inspect src/main.c and Makefile
steps.detail: Open src/main.c and Makefile in Monaco Editor cleanly from the left Explorer sidebar.

guides.title: 2. Validate SDK, Compile Firmware & Flash via XMODEM
guides.description: Diagnose your local VEGA toolchain, run Make builds, and upload artifacts safely.

steps.title: Configure Local SDK & Toolchain Paths
steps.detail: Point VEGA Studio to your host VEGA SDK directory and riscv32-vega-elf toolchain bin without altering global PATH.

steps.title: Run SDK Doctor Diagnostics
steps.detail: Confirm compiler target triple execution, GNU Make, Python 3, and vega_xmodem.py static checks pass.

steps.title: Run Make Build & Inspect Diagnostics
steps.detail: Trigger Build in the bottom panel. Click any parsed warning or error to jump to line/column in Monaco or ask Native AI.

steps.title: Run Upload Preflight & Flash Hardware
steps.detail: Disconnect Serial Monitor cleanly, select the USB-UART port (/dev/ttyUSB0 or COMx), review preflight checks, and confirm upload.

steps.title: Monitor Live UART Output
steps.detail: Open Serial Monitor, choose matching baud rate (e.g., 115200 8N1), and inspect live board logs.

guides.title: 3. Source Control, GitHub & Safe AI Assistance
guides.description: Manage commits cleanly and use Native VEGA AI + OpenCode without sacrificing workspace or credential safety.

steps.title: Track Firmware in Git & GitHub
steps.detail: Initialize Git inside your project folder, review file diffs in Monaco, and push cleanly using GitHub CLI (gh).

steps.title: Ask Native VEGA AI with Scoped Context
steps.detail: Configure OpenAI, Groq, or local Ollama in OS Credential Manager and attach selected code, compiler errors, or serial lines.

steps.title: Use OpenCode CLI with Explicit Approvals
steps.detail: For multi-file tasks with OpenCode CLI, retain Ask Before Actions mode and inspect diffs cleanly.
